Jordan Rivera
Senior Backend Engineer — Distributed Systems
jordan.rivera@example.com | github.com/jordanrivera

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 7 years building high-throughput data and payments systems.
Focused on reliability, observability, and pragmatic delivery.

EXPERIENCE

Northwind Payments — Staff Engineer (2022–present)

Problem: Payment settlement jobs ran nightly and frequently missed the banking cutoff, delaying merchant payouts.
Action: Re-architected the settlement pipeline into idempotent, sharded workers with a replayable event log.
Result: Cut settlement runtime from 6 hours to 40 minutes and eliminated missed banking cutoffs for 18 straight months.

Problem: On-call engineers had no way to trace a single payment across seven services.
Action: Introduced distributed tracing and a correlation-id standard adopted across all payment services.
Result: Reduced mean time to resolution for payment incidents from 3 hours to 25 minutes.

Cirrus Analytics — Senior Software Engineer (2018–2022)

Problem: The analytics API buckled under quarterly reporting load, timing out for enterprise customers.
Action: Added a read-through cache and query-planner hints, and moved heavy aggregations to a columnar store.
Result: Sustained 12x peak traffic with p99 latency under 300ms and zero reporting-window outages.

SKILLS
Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, gRPC, AWS, Kubernetes, distributed systems, observability.
